question: Compute Pearson correlations between all gene-methylation site pairs (all-vs-all) using DNA methylation beta values and gene expression values from the same samples. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction globally across all pairs. Identify gene-methylation site pairs with significant negative correlations (FDR < 0.05).

expected_output.guidelines: Gene-site pairs must match the reference as an unordered set; correlation values within +/-1e-4, P-values and FDR values within 1% relative absolute error; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
